subject: planner: support Selection operator in JoinGroup for the new join reorder (#66681)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent, focusing on `pkg/planner/core/joinorder/*`. The change allows join-group extraction to look through `LogicalSelection` (guarded by `tidb_opt_join_reorder_through_sel` and `expression.IsMutableEffectsExpr` filtering) and threads Selection conditions into the CD-C conflict detector as a Selection-derived edge with TES set to the Selection subtree vertex set, so conditions are preserved/consumed during join enumeration (otherwise reorder is skipped and the original tree is returned). No plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in this change; later history up to `upstream/master` does not contain follow-up fixes for this Selection support logic.
